# wizwalker (third-party, vendored dependency)

Upstream: https://github.com/wizwalker/wizwalker (version 1.8.1 reviewed), licence GPL-3.0
(`wizwalker-master/LICENSE`, unmodified).

This is **not** reference material. Maelstrom's `WizwalkerOperation` and `tools/wizwalker_adapter.py` import this
source and refuse to run unless its sha256 tree digest matches the pinned value
(`99f0eec7e15da862893bcf6aa3d89c3d1538c0a022c04f198d490cf383cdb2d1`; see
`tools/fixtures/wizwalker_review.json`). Do not edit these files; update the pin and re-review instead.
Only the observation entry points listed in `docs/WIZWALKER_ADAPTER_20261110.md` are used.

Moved from `ProjectMaelstrom/ProjectMaelstrom/Scripts/Library/wizwalker/wizwalker-master/` on 2026-11-19.
